title: Brutal Typing
description: Ridiculous-Coding for Minecraft: every keystroke in chat detonates with explosions, fire and screen shake that scale with how fast you type. Client-side, purely for fun.
body:
# Brutal Typing

**Ridiculous-Coding for Minecraft.** Every keystroke in chat and text fields detonates - explosions, fire, soul fire, brutal flying letters, screen shake and explosion sounds. The faster you type, the hotter the **amplifier** gets: bigger booms, hotter letters, higher-pitched sound, harder shake. Stop typing and it cools down, draining your combo. Pure dopamine, purely for fun.

> Beta - client-side only.

## Features
- Explosions, fire, soul fire, brutal flying letters, screen shake & explosion sounds on every keystroke
- An **amplifier** that heats up the faster you type: `COLD -> WARM -> HOT -> BRUTAL -> INFERNO -> APOCALYPSE`
- **ALL-CAPS importance**, spacebar **impact frames**, falling **weapon drops**, and a **send-slam** animation
- Varied delete sounds, crit stars, enchant sparkles, milestone fireworks
- Tabbed settings GUI (Mod Menu or a keybind) with a live "try it here" box

## Requirements
Minecraft **26.1.2** (Fabric) - **Fabric API** - **Mod Menu** (optional, for the settings GUI)

## Configure
**Mod Menu -> Brutal Typing**, or bind a key under **Options -> Controls -> Brutal Typing**.

Inspired by the *Ridiculous Coding* and *Power Mode* VS Code extensions.
